reviews.title: Driving Log is worthless
reviews.text: As someone else also noted, recent update killed previously logged night hours, and now gives no option to log day or night separately. If a night hour requirement exists for the state you live in, but the app doesn’t allow you to log it, then what is the point of having the driving log. Pointed this out to support chat and was told  that they can’t retrieve the hours lost and there’s no fix to the log at this time. Perceived value of the service was great, actual value is worthless.

reviews.title: Driver’s Log Issues
reviews.text: While the program is good, the app is terrible. At one point logging the hours went from newest to oldest and then changed, meaning you had to scroll all the way to the bottom to see the most recent. Not a huge deal, but inconvenient. Recently, then, with almost reaching the end of logging hours, the night hours logged completely disappeared and it is no longer working to select night or day hours. We were literally two hours away from being done. I don’t know what changed, but customer service was absolutely no help in resolving the issue. Just beware that in a span of nine months the app (at least the driver’s log) has changed several times and not for the better.

reviews.title: WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE OF ALL TIME
reviews.text:
Me (16) and my dad got rejected from the DMV today because a box that we were supposed to tick off was not checked (we were getting a learners permit) After that horrific DMV experience we call aceable saying our expirience and we get redirected to a random guy from India. That’s fine, but the thing is, HE WAS THE WORST GUY WE COULD’VE TALKED TO. He told us information we already knew and told us to go back after we had JUST BEEN REJECTED, saying “we had the right information” and also said we had to pay 10 bucks, and RESTART THE COURSE IVE SPENT 6 MONTHS ON. We had to call some other company because of how unhelpful aceable was, they were genuinely worse than the DMV, that has got to be an achievement no other company has claimed.
DO NOT USE THIS APP!!!!

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text: This program is easy to use, but the information they give you not correct. For instance, the information they tell you to have for Texas DPS contradicts what Texas DPS says when you arrive. They also have horrible customer service. There call center is not in US and the representatives do not understand the rules/laws. If you live in Texas do not use this program. Pay for an actual in person taught program. This course is not worth the headache of jumping through hoops trying to meet Texas DPS requirements when this course doesn’t meet all the requirements.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: I paid extra for each of my twins to have the Learners Permit preparation course. They both completed it and passed the practice test without issue. Took their actual permit test today and failed before getting through 3/4 of the questions. They both said so many of the questions and even the road signs they were asked about on their test weren’t in the course. Completely deflated the confidence of both of my honors/AP high school students. It also doesn’t even show me one of my twins test results on my side of the app but it shows on hers what her grade was.

reviews.title: Not Worth an Arm, Leg, or Even a Left Hand Side Air Bag
reviews.text:
The app is frustratingly buggy, logging in constantly fails, and at times it completely locks you out (for months). It’s difficult to use between phone and computer, making the course unnecessarily stressful and non-versatile, whatever you start logged in on STAY logged in on or risk being locked out.

Customer service is unhelpful and rigid, offering no real solutions when trying to fix your course issues, and seeming more interested in collecting money than assisting users, wanting you to buy an entirely new course if time runs out, even to extenuating circumstances. I cannot recommend this app. Especially don’t buy it unless you have a perfect track record of free time and 0 family emergencies because if you don’t complete the course, you basically get robbed! 0% moneyback guarantee.
